name: KromiumJsDialog
summary: Encapsulates a JavaScript alert, confirm, or prompt dialog with thread-safe continuation.

properties.name: message
properties.description: The text message displayed by the dialog.

properties.name: defaultPromptText
properties.description: The default input text if type is PROMPT.

properties.name: originUrl
properties.description: The URL of the web page that initiated the dialog.

properties.name: isHandled
properties.description: Indicates whether this dialog has already been confirmed or cancelled.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms or accepts the dialog. For prompts, passes promptResult back to the JavaScript engine.
